title: Ethereal City Sunset
description: Two translucent female figures with flowing green and yellow hair merge into a surreal cityscape at sunset. A glowing sun sits between them while a curving elevated highway with light trails cuts through the foreground, leading toward a dense skyline of skyscrapers under a dramatic orange and purple sky.
prompt: Surreal impressionistic cityscape at sunset featuring two large translucent female profiles with flowing lime green and golden hair merging into the scene, a bright glowing sun between them, dramatic curving elevated highway with light trails in the foreground, dense futuristic skyscrapers in the background, vibrant orange and purple cloudy sky, painterly brushwork, atmospheric and dreamlike
